description: List campaigns in a LinkedIn ad account. Returns campaign name, status, objectiveType (WEBSITE_VISITS/LEAD_GENERATION/BRAND_AWARENESS/etc.), optimizationTargetType, bid amount, daily/total budget, run schedule, and targeting criteria summary. Filter by status or campaign_group_id. Use li_get_campaign for full targeting detail on a specific campaign.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account numeric ID or URN. Defaults to LINKEDIN_DEFAULT_AD_ACCOUNT.

campaign_group_id.description: Filter to campaigns belonging to a specific campaign group (numeric ID or URN).

status.description: Filter by campaign status. Omit to return campaigns in all statuses.

name: li_list_campaigns
